## Import libraries

```{r}
#| include: false

library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)

figure_output <- paste0(getwd(), "/figures")
```

### Define cell markers

```{r}
mk_rgc <- c("Isl1", "Pou4f1", "Pou4f2", "Pou6f2", "Elavl4", "Elovl4", "Ebf1", "Ebf2", "Rbpms", "Stmn3", "Atoh7")
mk_rgc_subtype <- c("Satb1", "Foxp1", "Foxp2")
mk_axon_guidance <- c("Dcc", "Nrp1", "Plxnc1", "Igfbpl1",  "Plxnb2", "Vldlr", "Fgfr1op2", "Fgfr1op", "Dscam", "Nrxn3", "Nrxn2", "Nrxn1", "Ephb1", "Igf1r", "App", "Lrrc4c", "Robo2")
```

## Mouse Retinas

### Load data

```{r}
#| include: false

seu_obj_mm <- readRDS(paste0(getwd(), "/processed_dataset/MmRetina_filtered_integrated.rds"))
```

### Group assignment

```{r}
# All
seu_obj_mm$exp_group <- "Others"
# POU4F2 and RCVRN
seu_obj_mm$exp_group[WhichCells(seu_obj_mm, expression = Pou4f2 > 0 & Rcvrn > 0)] <- "Pou4f2/Rcvrn"
# POU4F2 only
seu_obj_mm$exp_group[WhichCells(seu_obj_mm, expression = Pou4f2 > 0 & Rcvrn <= 0)] <- "Pou4f2"
# RCVRN only
seu_obj_mm$exp_group[WhichCells(seu_obj_mm, expression = Pou4f2 <= 0 & Rcvrn > 0)] <- "Rcvrn"
```

### Plots

Dot plot output: 2200px \* 1800px

```{r}
seu_obj_mm_sub <- subset(seu_obj_mm, subset = exp_group != "Others")

DotPlot(
  seu_obj_mm_sub,
  features = c(mk_rgc, mk_rgc_subtype),
  group.by = "exp_group",
  cols = c("white", "navy"),
  scale = FALSE
) +
  labs(title = "RGCs", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = c(
    "Pou4f2" = expression("Pou4f2"^"+"),
    "Pou4f2/Rcvrn" = expression("Pou4f2"^"+" ~ "/ Rcvrn"^"+"),
    "Rcvrn" = expression("Rcvrn"^"+")
  )) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 1),
    axis.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 1),
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )
ggsave(filename = "f8a.tiff", path = figure_output, width = 2200, height = 1800, units = "px", dpi = 300)

DotPlot(
  seu_obj_mm_sub,
  features = mk_axon_guidance,
  group.by = "exp_group",
  cols = c("white", "navy"),
  scale = FALSE
) +
  labs(title = "Axon guidance", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = c(
    "Pou4f2" = expression("Pou4f2"^"+"),
    "Pou4f2/Rcvrn" = expression("Pou4f2"^"+" ~ "/ Rcvrn"^"+"),
    "Rcvrn" = expression("Rcvrn"^"+")
  )) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 1),
    axis.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 1),
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )
ggsave(filename = "f8b.tiff", path = figure_output, width = 2200, height = 1800, units = "px", dpi = 300)
```
